Service Requirements The Contractor must provide printing services, including the following tasks: • Graphic design and creation of annual report content for various Embassy offices. • Graphic design and creation of brochures, information portfolios, folders, advertising publications, flyers, and similar materials for the Embassy's promotional events. • Printing and/or photocopying of documents, brochures, and portfolios in a professional manner, ensuring clear colors, photographs, text, and images for finished products. Preference will be given to contractors offering multiple printing methods, such as commercial, digital, press, and web-based printing. • Supplying stock images for publications, as needed. • Providing printing designs for requesting offices to review and confirm prior to production. The Contractor is responsible for installing, setting up, and delivering printed items to U.S. Embassy Hanoi events. • Material Requirements: The Contractor shall present several material options for the Embassy's selection prior to submitting a quote. Services must include all necessary supplies — such as equipment, toner, developer, fuser agent, staples, paper, g

The Contractor shall deliver fully operational, integrated, and sustained EW SITE systems and sub-system components for domestic and Foreign Military Sales (FMS) customers. The required outcome is an EW SITE system capable of supporting a multitude of laboratory-specific System Configurations across multiple platforms (EA-18G, F/A-18, MH-60) while maintaining configuration consistency with the Advanced Weapons Laboratory (AWL) at NAWCWD China Lake, CA. Additionally, the Contractor shall ensure continuous operational readiness of current EW SITE systems through comprehensive lifecycle support, including on-call and on-site maintenance, system upgrades, replacement parts provisioning, and personnel training. REQUIREMENTS TO THE EXPERT TEAM 7.1. To ensure the proper quality of the learning materials and trainings in cybersecurity for information security managers, the Contractor must engage an expert team (at least 4 persons) including: project manager; lead cybersecurity expert; methodologist / curriculum developer; trainers / lecturers. All expert must meet the below criteria: experience: academic degree in IT or cybersecurity and at least 5 years of work experience in information security/cyber protection; management/professional experience: at least 3 years of experience in management positions in information security (CISO, security director, head of the cyber protection unit) or as a senior architect/auditor of information security systems; didactical/trainer experience: at least 1 year of experience in conducting learning courses, trainings, workshops or seminars for adult participa

ity systems; didactical/trainer experience: at least 1 year of experience in conducting learning courses, trainings, workshops or seminars for adult participants in IT/cybersecurity with a duration of at least 1 year; development experience: author or co-author of learning programmes, courses (including online courses), methodological recommendations or learning and methodological complexes; fluent in Ukrainian. 7.2. To meet the requirements as per 7.1., the tenderer must: - provide her/his surname, name, citizenship, positions, and education in Annex 3; - provide the copies of her/his education documents (copies of diplomas or certificates, CV). By signing and sending Annex 3, the tenderer confirms and guarantees that she/he has a written/electronic (QES-signed) consent to personal data processing from all persons involved by the tenderer in the procurement procedure in any way. 7.3.
